title: Coupled but Late: Turn-Taking Between Full-Duplex Speech Models in Unscripted Dialogue

paragraphs.en: Full-duplex speech models are trained to converse with a person, but they are increasingly made to converse with each other, in self-play data generation, agent societies, and model-based evaluation. In that loop no human absorbs a timing error: each model’s turn-taking is the other’s input. We ask what timing the loop settles into. Two PersonaPlex-7B instances exchange audio tokens on a shared clock in unscripted conversation, and one floor-transfer rule is applied to them and to Switchboard. Their timing is coupled: re-pairing speakers across conversations destroys it. But the floor changes hands late, at a median of 400–560 ms against 137 ms for humans, and the last 120 ms of the partner’s turn, where human projection places a tenth of its transfers, holds 1% of theirs. Delaying one direction of the channel shifts the response one-for-one and leaves the run-up to it empty, consistent with a reactive wait after the perceived end rather than the turn-end projection human timing requires.
paragraphs.zh: 全双工语音模型最初是训练用来与人对话的，但如今它们越来越多地被用于相互对话，例如在自对弈数据生成、智能体社会以及基于模型的评估中。在这种循环中，没有任何人类来吸收时间同步错误：每个模型的轮次转换都成为另一个模型的输入。我们想知道这种循环最终会稳定到怎样的时间节奏上。两个 PersonaPlex-7B 实例在没有脚本的对话中，通过共享时钟交换音频标记，并且对它们以及 Switchboard 数据集都应用了相同的“发言权转移”规则。它们的时间同步是耦合的：在不同对话之间重新配对说话者就会破坏这种同步。然而，发言权的转移发生得较晚，中位时间为 400–560 毫秒，而人类仅为 137 毫秒；此外，在对方轮次的最后 120 毫秒内——人类预测仅在此处安排了十分之一的发言权转移——它们却占据了 1% 的转移。延迟通信通道中的一个方向，会导致响应以一对一的方式滞后，而该响应的准备阶段则保持空着；这与人类时间同步所依赖的“在轮次结束预测之后进行主动等待”不同，反而更像是感知到对方结束后的被动等待。

paragraphs.en: A full-duplex speech model listens while it speaks and decides for itself when to take the floor [ 1 , 2 ] . It is trained and evaluated as one side of a conversation whose other side is a person or a recording standing in for one. Increasingly, though, two such models are placed in a loop with no person in it: to generate self-play dialogue data [ 3 , 4 ] , to populate spoken agent societies [ 5 ] , or to act as an automated examiner for another model [ 6 ] . In that loop nobody absorbs a timing error: whatever one model does at the floor is the input on which the other decides, and what timing the loop settles into has no answer in single-model evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 全双工语音模型在说话的同时也会倾听，并自行决定何时发言 [ 1 , 2 ]。它被训练和评估为对话的一方，而另一方则是一个人或代表人的录音。然而，越来越多的情况下，两个这样的模型会形成一个没有人类参与的循环：用于生成自对弈对话数据 [ 3 , 4 ]、构建语音智能体社会 [ 5]，或作为另一个模型的自动考官 [ 6]。在这种循环中，没有人来吸收时间同步错误：一个模型在发言时所做的任何行为都会成为另一个模型决策的输入，而循环最终达到的时间同步状态，在单模型评估中是没有答案的。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks score one model against fixed stimuli or an examiner [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 6 ] , and the model–model dyads built so far serve other questions: SyncLLM compares two agents’ gap and overlap statistics with human continuations under communication delay [ 10 ] , dGSLM generates both channels from one model and tabulates them against Fisher [ 11 ] , Riera et al. [ 12 ] route audio tokens between two Moshi instances, as we do, to study representational synchronization, and Agentic-DuplexGen has two duplex models perform a written script and reports their floor-transfer offsets [ 3 ] . None measures floor timing for freely generated dyads under controls, or asks whether a difference from human timing belongs to the models or to the channel between them. On the policy side the question has a sharper form. Classical dialogue systems end-point on a silence threshold, so they can only react to a turn that has already ended [ 13 ] ; humans project turn ends and start 100 to 200 ms after them [ 14 ] , and projection models such as VAP are built to do the same [ 15 ] . Which of the two a duplex model implements when it talks to another duplex model is not known.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试通过固定刺激或考官来评估模型的性能 [7, 8, 9, 6]，而迄今为止构建的模型-模型配对则服务于其他研究问题：SyncLLM 在存在通信延迟的情况下，将两个智能体之间的差异与重叠统计量与人类的延续性表现进行比较 [10]；dGSLM 从一个模型中生成两个通道，并将其与 Fisher 的方法进行表格化对比 [11]；Riera 等人 [12] 像我们一样，在两个 Moshi 实例之间传输音频标记，以研究表征同步问题；Agentic-DuplexGen 则让两个双工模型执行书面脚本，并报告它们的“地板转移”偏移量 [3]。这些方法均未在受控条件下测量自由生成的配对模型之间的“地板”时序，也未探讨与人类时序的差异究竟源于模型本身，还是源于它们之间的通信通道。在策略层面，这一问题表现得更为明确。传统的对话系统以沉默阈值作为结束标志，因此它们只能对已经结束的轮次做出反应 [13]；而人类会在轮次结束后 100 至 200 毫秒内预测其结束并开始下一轮次 [14]，VAP 等预测模型正是为此目的而构建的 [15]。目前尚不清楚，当一个双工模型与另一个双工模型对话时，它究竟采用了上述两种方法中的哪一种。

paragraphs.en: We answer it for PersonaPlex-7B. One floor-transfer rule, applied by the same code to both agents and to Switchboard word alignments, gives the timing; three agent-side segmentations bound its dependence on speech boundaries; re-pairing speakers and silencing the partner test what the timing depends on; and a latency adjustment and a one-sided delay sweep test whether the channel explains it. The timing is coupled, it is late, and the lateness behaves like a reactive policy rather than like the channel’s delay. A secondary intervention shows that the opening register the models bring from training yields to a sentence placed in one agent’s speech.
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对 PersonaPlex-7B 进行了分析。一条适用于智能体和 Switchboard 词对齐的楼层转换规则给出了时间信息；智能体侧的三个分片限制了其对于语音边界的依赖；重新配对说话者并使搭档静音，则检验了时间信息所依赖的因素；而延迟调整和单侧延迟扫描则检验了信道是否对此负有责任。该时间信息是耦合的，存在延迟，且这种延迟表现得像一种反应式策略，而非信道的延迟。一项次要干预表明，模型从训练中继承的初始注册信息会因某句话被置于一个智能体的语音中而让位。

paragraphs.en: Conversations. Two PersonaPlex-7B agents ( nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1 ), one per GPU, exchange Mimi audio tokens [ 1 ] at 12.5 Hz (Fig. 1 ). At each 80 ms step an agent receives the tokens its partner emitted at the previous step; nothing on the path is audio, so no recognizer, synthesizer, or re-encoding adds its own timing. A partner’s frame becomes readable after 160 ms on the coarse codebook and 240 ms on the fine ones, from one frame of buffering plus the model’s codebook schedule; an agent can still start before its partner stops. The baseline is 36 seeded 90 s conversations in five scenes that put both speakers in one place, such as an apartment laundry room. Personas and scenes enter as system prompts, temperatures are 0.8 for audio and 0.7 for text, and every matched condition keeps personas, scenes, voices, and seeds fixed; audio is decoded afterwards for measurement only.
paragraphs.zh: 对话。两个 PersonaPlex-7B 智能体（nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1），每个 GPU 运行一个，以 12.5 Hz 的速率交换 Mimi 音频标记 [1]（图 1）。在每个 80 ms 的步骤中，一个智能体会接收到其对话伙伴在上一步骤中发出的标记；路径上没有任何音频内容，因此没有识别器、合成器或重新编码过程会添加自身的时序。由于存在一帧的缓冲以及模型自身的码本调度机制，对话伙伴的帧在粗码本上需要 160 ms、在细码本上需要 240 ms 才能被读取；即便如此，一个智能体仍可以在其对话伙伴停止之前开始发言。基线实验包括 36 段以随机种子初始化的 90 秒对话，场景共有五个，所有对话中的两位说话者均处于同一地点，例如公寓的洗衣房。人物设定和场景作为系统提示输入，音频的温度设为 0.8，文本的温度设为 0.7；在所有匹配条件下，人物设定、场景、语音和随机种子均保持固定；音频仅用于测量而在之后进行解码。

paragraphs.en: Floor-transfer offset. Speech spans separated by less than 180 ms merge into inter-pausal units (IPUs), and following Heldner and Edlund [ 16 ] a floor transfer is the interval from the end of the current speaker’s IPU to the start of the next speaker’s,
paragraphs.zh: 话语轮次转换偏移。间隔时间少于 180 毫秒的话语片段会合并为停顿间单位（IPU）；根据 Heldner 和 Edlund [16] 的研究，话语轮次转换是指当前说话者的 IPU 结束到下一位说话者开始之间的时间间隔。

paragraphs.en: positive for a gap and negative for an overlap. An IPU wholly inside the other speaker’s does not transfer the floor; identical-extent IPUs are resolved by who holds the floor, so counts do not depend on speaker order. No lexical backchannel filter is applied [ 17 ] ; under the shared rule, nested IPUs are 14% of different-speaker adjacencies for humans against 14–16% for the agents, and sub-second IPUs 43% against 45% under the primary instrument (50% and 84% under the word segmentations, which cut at word boundaries). Offsets are clipped at ± 2 \pm 2 s. We report the median, the overlap fraction ( FTO < − 10 \mathrm{FTO}<-10 ms, a margin that excludes exact zeros on the 80 ms grid), the share within ± 120 \pm 120 ms of zero, and the Wasserstein-1 distance W 1 W_{1} between the clipped distributions, in milliseconds. The ± 120 \pm 120 ms window, the near-zero band , follows Heldner’s detection thresholds for gaps and overlaps [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 正值表示存在间隙，负值则表示存在重叠。一个完全位于另一说话者 IPU 内部的 IPU 不会导致话权转移；范围相同的 IPU 则根据谁持有话权进行判定，因此计数不依赖于说话者的顺序。未应用任何词汇性反馈通道过滤器 [17]；在共享规则下，嵌套 IPU 在人类对话中占不同说话者相邻 IPU 的 14%，而在智能体中则为 14%–16%；在主要工具下，持续时间小于 1 秒的 IPU 占比为 43%，而在词分段（以词界为分割点）下则分别为 50% 和 84%。偏移量被截断在 ±2 \pm 2 秒范围内。我们报告了中位数、重叠比例（FTO < −10 \mathrm{FTO}<-10 毫秒，这一阈值排除了 80 毫秒网格上的精确零值）、在 ±120 \pm 120 毫秒范围内的零值比例，以及截断分布之间的 Wasserstein-1 距离 W_1（单位：毫秒）。±120 \pm 120 毫秒的窗口（即接近零值的区间）遵循 Heldner 对间隙和重叠的检测阈值 [18]。

paragraphs.en: Reference and segmentation. The same extraction function runs on the released MS-State word alignments for Switchboard [ 19 , 20 ] : 193,115 transfers from 2,407 calls with at least 20 each. Its median of 137 ms sits below the 168 ms of Roberts et al. [ 21 ] because IPU-level segmentation with backchannels retained counts shorter intervals. Switchboard is telephone speech between strangers while the agents share a scene; the two settings differ, and the recorded-partner arm of Sec. 3.4 gives the co-present comparison. Agent speech has no aligner, so we segment it three ways: decoded-audio energy above 0.01 RMS, the primary instrument, which applies unchanged to live and recorded partners and carries through every control; word extents from the text stream; and words aligned to the voiced runs that contain them. The rule is shared, the boundary estimators are not, and the spread across the three is a sensitivity result.
paragraphs.zh: 参考与分段。相同的提取函数也运行在已发布的 MS-State 词对齐数据（Switchboard [19, 20]）上：来自 2,407 通通话的 193,115 次转移，每通通话至少包含 20 次转移。其 137 毫秒的中位数低于 Roberts 等人 [21] 的 168 毫秒，这是因为保留了回信通道的 IPU 级分段计算出的时间间隔更短。Switchboard 是陌生人之间的电话对话，而智能体则共享同一场景；这两种设置存在差异，第 3.4 节中“录音搭档”部分提供了共处一室情况下的对比。智能体的语音没有对齐器，因此我们采用三种方式对其进行分段：解码音频能量高于 0.01 RMS 的情况（这是主要方法，对现场和录音搭档均适用，并在所有控制实验中保持一致）；文本流中的词范围；以及与包含这些词的有声语段对齐的词语。规则是共享的，但边界估计器并非如此，三种方法之间的差异反映了敏感性的结果。

paragraphs.en: Inference. Bootstrap intervals resample conversations with the human reference fixed; paired intervals invert the sign-flip test. The reporting cutoff is 0.05 / 45 0.05/45 , a conservative divisor kept to avoid post-hoc relaxation; the baseline timing contrasts, the re-pairing control, and the whole-conversation opener contrasts pass it, the rest is nominal. The appendices carry the statistical notes with the enumerated tests and the clip and grid sensitivity checks.
paragraphs.zh: 推断。Bootstrap 置信区间在固定人类参考的情况下对对话进行重采样；配对置信区间则反转符号翻转检验。报告阈值为 0.05 / 45 0.05/45，这是一个保守的除数，用以避免事后放宽标准；基线时间对比、重新配对控制以及整个对话的开场对比均通过了该阈值，其余则为名义值。附录中包含了统计说明，其中列出了各项检验以及剪辑和网格敏感性检查。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Fig. 2 a compare the baseline dyads with full-call Switchboard. Under every segmentation the agents’ median offset is three to four times the human one, and the near-zero band, which holds a quarter of human transfers, holds 3 to 9% of theirs. The distribution is not merely wide: 44% of all transfers fall at 400 or 480 ms, a sharp peak with no counterpart in the human histogram. Fig. 3 a shows one opening: after a simultaneous start, the agents hand over at 320 to 640 ms and once at 1360 ms, the Switchboard callers at 9 and 45 ms, once in overlap, and twice after longer gaps. Measurement does not manufacture this. The three segmentations move the median by up to 160 ms and leave both deficits in place; the first-90-second reference, which matches conversation phase, brings the human side closer and leaves them too; and the observed W 1 W_{1} is several times the sampling null of Table 1 , with every one of the 36 conversations above its own size-matched null (sign test, p = 2.9 × 10 − 11 p=2.9\times 10^{-11} ). Shifting the human reference to the agents’ median isolates shape from location: the agents overlap more than a merely delayed human would, so their lower overlap is the same lateness seen again, not a second deficit, and the near-zero deficit survives the shift under two of the three segmentations.
paragraphs.zh: 表1和图2a将基准双人对话与完整通话的Switchboard进行了比较。在所有分段条件下，智能体的中位数偏移都是人类偏移量的三到四倍；而包含人类四分之一的转接的近零区间，在智能体中仅占3%到9%。这种分布不仅范围宽泛：所有转接中有44%落在400或480毫秒处，形成一个在人类直方图中没有对应项的尖锐峰值。图3a展示了一次开始阶段的情况：在同步启动后，智能体在320至640毫秒之间完成交接，另一次则在1360毫秒；而Switchboard的通话者则分别在9和45毫秒时完成，一次发生在重叠期间，另两次则发生在更长的间隔之后。这种结果并非测量方法所制造出来的。三种分段方式最多将中位数移动了160毫秒，但并未消除这两种缺陷；以对话阶段为基准的前90秒参考值使人类一侧的结果更接近，但缺陷依然存在；此外，观测到的W₁ W₁是表1中采样零值的数倍，且36次对话中的每一次都超过了其自身规模匹配的零值（符号检验，p = 2.9 × 10⁻¹¹）。将人类参考值调整至智能体的中位数，可以将形状与位置分离：智能体的重叠程度高于单纯延迟的人类对话，因此它们较低的重叠度反映的是同样存在的延迟问题，而非第二个缺陷；而在三种分段中的两种情况下，近零缺陷在调整之后仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: A shared clock alone does not make two speakers a conversation, so the first control asks whether the timing belongs to the pair. Pairing agent A of conversation i i with agent B of conversation j ≠ i j\neq i keeps each speaker’s activity track and the clock and removes only the original partner; two monologues on a common clock would be unaffected. Instead (Table 1 ) the re-paired median collapses toward zero, overlap more than doubles, the interquartile range widens from 160 to 1360 ms, and the distance to the human reference grows; the real dyads sit outside all 2,000 re-pairings on every statistic. Same-scene re-pairings reproduce the free surrogate, so the structure belongs to the original pairing, not to the clock or the scene. The second control replaces the partner’s audio with encoded silence in twelve matched cells: transfers fall from 273 to 26 and words per agent from 134 to 29; the agents say their opening line and stop. Partner audio sustains speaking at all, a production result rather than a timing one, but it rules out agents talking past each other on a schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭共享时钟本身，并不能使两位说话者构成一场对话，因此第一个对照实验旨在判断这种时间同步性是否属于该对话对。将对话 i 中的智能体 A 与对话 j（j ≠ i）中的智能体 B 配对，会保留每位说话者的活动轨迹和时钟信息，但仅移除原始搭档；若两人在同一共享时钟上进行独白，则不受影响。相反（见表1），重新配对的中间值趋近于零，重叠时间增加了一倍以上，四分位距从160毫秒扩大到1360毫秒，且与人类参考值的距离也增大；在所有统计指标上，真实的对话对都位于2000次重新配对结果之外。同一场景下的重新配对重现了自由替代样本的结果，因此这种结构源于原始配对，而非时钟或场景本身。第二个对照实验将搭档的音频替换为编码后的静默，涉及十二个匹配单元格：传输次数从273降至26，每位智能体的发言词数从134降至29；智能体仅说出第一句话便停止。搭档音频的存在使对话始终持续进行，这是一个制作层面的结果而非时间同步性的结果，但这一结果排除了智能体按照预定时间表相互错开说话的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The channel adds up to 240 ms of delay, so the obvious explanation is the link. Two observations rule it out as the whole story. Subtracting the full 240 ms from every transfer (Table 1 , “ − - 240”) leaves a median of 240 ms, still above both human references, and the near-zero band at half the human share; a constant cannot fix a shape. And the last 120 ms of the partner’s turn, where projection shows, is nearly empty: humans place a tenth of their transfers there, the agents one percent, two with the link delay removed. The agents do overlap, on 18% of transfers, but almost all of that mass lies deeper inside the partner’s turn (beyond 120 ms, where the median is − 560 -560 ms against − 311 -311 ms): interruption, not projection [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 该信道的总延迟为 240 毫秒，因此最明显的解释是链路问题。但有两项观察结果排除了这种可能性，说明事情并非如此简单。如果从每次传输中减去全部 240 毫秒（表 1，“− - 240”），剩余延迟的中位数仍为 240 毫秒，高于两种人类参考值，且其带宽接近于零，仅为人类带宽的一半；一个常数无法改变分布形态。此外，在搭档回合的最后 120 毫秒内，根据预测显示，几乎没有数据传输：人类在此阶段传输的数据量占其总传输量的十分之一，而智能体仅占百分之一（若去除链路延迟，则占百分之二）。智能体确实存在重叠现象，发生在 18% 的传输中，但这些数据几乎全部位于搭档回合的更深处（超过 120 毫秒的位置，此时中位数为 −560 毫秒，而人类参考值则为 −311 毫秒）：这表明是中断，而非预测 [14]。

paragraphs.en: The delay sweep asks what the wait is anchored to: B’s tokens reach A D ∈ { 3 , 8 , 10 , 15 } D\in\{3,8,10,15\} frames late while A’s reach B on time, 36 conversations per level. A’s pooled response mode moves by exactly D D at every level while B’s stays at six frames (Fig. 2 b; Table 1 ); per conversation the modal wait beyond the delay has a median of four and a half to six frames and lies within one frame of six in 18 to 28 of the 35 or 36 conversations at each level, with ties between modal frames resolved to the earlier one. Measured from the moment B’s end becomes visible to A, the pooled wait is unchanged: it rides on the partner’s audio, and a partner that appears up to 1.2 s slower does not shorten the mode. Its shape says what kind of wait it is. Nine in ten of the agents’ positive offsets begin more than 320 ms after the partner’s end, against four in ten for humans, and the approach to that end holds one to two percent at every level. A late mode with the run-up to it unoccupied is consistent with a silence-threshold policy [ 13 ] and not with projection, which places part of its onsets in that run-up, delayed or not. After the 240 ms link, the model waits roughly one further link delay of silence before it speaks. Chang et al. [ 22 ] measure a 0.6 s generate-to-perceive lag in PersonaPlex during interruptions and call it state inertia; the wait here is consistent with it, though floor timing alone cannot identify the mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟扫描问题关注的是等待时间以什么为锚点：B 的 token 比 A 晚 D ∈ {3, 8, 10, 15} 帧到达，而 A 的 token 则准时到达 B；每个级别有 36 次对话。在每个级别中，A 的合并响应模式恰好移动 D 帧，而 B 的模式则保持在六帧（图 2b；表 1）；每次对话中，超出延迟部分的典型等待时间中位数为四到六点五帧，在每级的 35 或 36 次对话中，有 18 到 28 次的等待时间与六帧相差一帧以内（若典型帧数相同，则以较早者为准）。从 B 的结束时刻对 A 可见之时开始计算，合并后的等待时间保持不变：它依赖于对方的音频，而即使对方最多延迟 1.2 秒出现，也不会缩短这一典型模式。其形态揭示了这种等待的性质。十分之九的智能体的正向偏移始于对方结束后的 320 毫秒之后，而人类则为十分之四；在每个级别中，接近该结束时刻的偏移始终保持在百分之一点到二之间。一种在延迟模式下其准备阶段未被占用的模式，与沉默阈值策略 [13] 一致，而非预测机制——后者无论是否延迟，都会将部分起始点置于该准备阶段内。在 240 毫秒的连接期之后，模型会在沉默中等待大约一个连接期的延迟时间才开始说话。Chang 等人 [22] 在 PersonaPlex 系统中测得中断时存在 0.6 秒的“生成-感知”延迟，并将其称为状态惯性；此处的等待时间与这一现象一致，尽管仅凭底层时序无法确定具体机制。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the live partner with recorded human speech (72 runs over 24 windows from two AMI headset recordings [ 23 ] , level-matched and delivered one frame late for parity) removes the six-frame peak: that frame holds a third as many transfers as in live dyads, the median halves (Table 1 ), and the band share (0.16) sits inside the range of a mismatched-window surrogate (0.11 to 0.19). A recording never yields the floor to the agent, and the agents mostly do not take it; their speech share halves. The 480 ms wait is therefore not a fixed latency applied to any input but what the model does when a partner yields. Replacing the partner also changes content and acoustics, so this arm shows condition dependence, not a closed-loop effect.
paragraphs.zh: 用录制的人类语音替代实时对话伙伴（使用来自两个 AMI 头戴设备录音的 24 个窗口中的 72 次运行 [23]，经过电平匹配，并延迟一帧播放以保持同步）后，六帧峰值消失了：该帧中的传输次数仅为实时对话对中的三分之一，中位数则减少了一半（表 1），而频段占比（0.16）处于不匹配窗口的替代样本范围（0.11 至 0.19）之内。录音从未将控制权交给智能体，而智能体也大多没有接受；它们的语音占比减少了一半。因此，480 毫秒的等待时间并非施加于任何输入上的固定延迟，而是模型在对话伙伴让出控制权时所采取的行为。替换对话伙伴也会改变内容和声学特征，因此这一实验组表现出对条件的依赖性，而非闭环效应。

paragraphs.en: The loop propagates more than timing. Placed in a laundry room, the models open in telephone or customer-service language: conversation 1 begins “Hi, this is Aria.” “Hi, Orion.” “Hi, how are you?” (Fig. 3 a). A 21-pattern lexicon written after inspecting the baseline counts 29 such phrases per thousand words in the first ten seconds and 2 to 4 afterwards (Fig. 3 b), consistent with the checkpoint’s customer-service training data [ 2 ] . Placing one of five scene-appropriate openers in one agent’s initial speech, with its timing left to the agent, cuts the opening rate from 29 to 12 ( − 16.9 -16.9 [ − 27.7 , − 6.0 ] [-27.7,-6.0] , nominal) and the whole-conversation rate from 7.6 to 2.2 ( − 5.4 -5.4 [ − 8.8 , − 2.2 ] [-8.8,-2.2] ; − 5.3 -5.3 with the forced tokens excluded). The effect sits with the agent that speaks the opener ( − 7.4 -7.4 [ − 11.2 , − 3.7 ] [-11.2,-3.7] ); its partner moves the same way without reaching the cutoff ( − 3.5 -3.5 [ − 7.9 , + 0.8 ] [-7.9,+0.8] ). The same sentence given as a system-prompt instruction is followed in only 8 of 36 runs and leaves the opening where it was (26.7), for − 2.6 -2.6 [ − 5.8 , + 0.6 ] [-5.8,+0.6] over the conversation: placed in the speech, the sentence reaches the register; told in the prompt, it does not reach the opening. Instruction following in duplex models is a benchmark target in its own right [ 24 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这种循环的影响不仅体现在时间上。将这些模型置于洗衣房中，它们会以电话或客服的语言风格开启对话：对话1以“你好，我是Aria。”“你好，Orion。”“你好吗？”（图3a）开始。在分析基准数据后编写的一个包含21种模式的词汇表显示，在前十秒内每千个词会出现29个此类短语，之后则为2到4个（图3b），这与检查点中的客服训练数据[2]一致。若将五个适合场景的开场白之一置于其中一个智能体的初始发言中，并将其出现时间交由智能体自行决定，则开场率会从29降至12（−16.9 [−27.7, −6.0]，名义显著），整个对话中的开场率则会从7.6降至2.2（−5.4 [−8.8, −2.2]；若排除强制标记，则为−5.3）。这种影响体现在说出开场白的智能体上（−7.4 [−11.2, −3.7]）；其对话伙伴的发言也朝相同方向变化，但未达到显著阈值（−3.5 [−7.9, +0.8]）。若将同一句话作为系统提示指令给出，在36次运行中仅有8次被遵循，且开场率仍维持原状（26.7），整个对话中的变化为−2.6 [−5.8, +0.6]：当这句话被置于实际发言中时，它能达到相应的表达风格；而当它仅作为提示指令给出时，则无法影响开场方式。在双工模型中遵循指令本身就是一个重要的基准目标[24]。

paragraphs.en: Two full-duplex models left to talk to each other are coupled but late: the floor changes hands three to four times later than between humans, at a wait anchored to the end of the partner’s audio, and the last 120 ms of the partner’s turn, where human projection places a tenth of its transfers, goes almost unused. Coupling is therefore no evidence of human-like timing, and dialogue generated by such a pair, or an examiner built from such a model, inherits a reactive endpointer’s floor. The result is for one checkpoint, with related lateness reported for its model family [ 22 , 25 ] ; the protocol applies unchanged to any duplex model. Code and measurements will be released; the appendices carry the statistical notes.
paragraphs.zh: 两个能够全双工通信的智能体模型虽然实现了耦合，但存在延迟问题：它们之间的对话轮次转换比人类晚三到四次，这种延迟源于对搭档音频结尾的等待；此外，在搭档发言的最后 120 毫秒中——这一时段本应占人类语音传递量的十分之一——几乎未被有效利用。因此，这种耦合关系并不能证明其具备类人类的时序能力，由此类智能体组合生成的对话，或由该模型构建的考官，都会继承这种反应式终点指示机制所导致的轮次延迟问题。目前仅在某个检查点观察到这一现象，其模型家族的相关延迟数据亦有记录 [22, 25]；该协议对任何双工模型均同样适用。相关代码与测量结果将公开发布，附录中附有统计说明。

paragraphs.en: This study used the publicly released MS-State word alignments for Switchboard and the AMI Meeting Corpus recordings, under their respective licenses. It involved no new human participants and required no new ethics approval.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究在各自许可协议下，使用了为 Switchboard 和 AMI 会议语料库录音公开发布的 MS-State 词对齐数据。研究未涉及任何新的人类参与者，也无需获得新的伦理批准。

paragraphs.en: These appendices are the audit trail behind the paper: the inferential statements behind the reporting cutoff, the intervals and sensitivity checks, and every condition in full, including rows the paper omits for space. Table and figure numbers without a prefix refer to the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 这些附录是本文的审计追踪记录：包括报告截止日期的推论陈述、时间间隔和敏感性检验，以及所有完整条件，其中也包含了因篇幅限制而未被纳入正文的行数据。无前缀的表格和图表编号均指代本文中的内容。

paragraphs.en: The multiplicity inventory enumerates 31 tests, reproduced in Table A2 . The paper’s cutoff is α ∗ = 0.05 / 45 ≈ 0.0011 \alpha_{*}=0.05/45\approx 0.0011 , a conservative divisor retained from the first analysis pass rather than relaxed after inspecting the results. Contrasts below the cutoff are the baseline timing contrasts (rows 1–9), the re-pairing controls (10–17), the silence control (22), the whole-conversation forced-opener contrasts (26, 28, 29), and the per-conversation W 1 W_{1} sign test (31). Tables A1 and A3 carry the nominal-level contrasts the paper also reports. All 95% intervals are marginal, not simultaneous.
paragraphs.zh: 多重性清单列出了31项测试，这些测试在表A2中重新呈现。该论文的临界值为 α∗ = 0.05 / 45 ≈ 0.0011，这是一个保守的除数，在首次分析阶段就已采用，而非在检查结果后才放宽。低于该临界值的对比包括基准时间对比（第1–9行）、重新配对对照（第10–17行）、沉默对照（第22行）、整个对话中的强制开场对比（第26、28、29行），以及每段对话的W₁符号检验（第31行）。表A1和表A3包含了论文中报告的名义水平对比。所有95%置信区间均为边际置信区间，而非同步置信区间。

paragraphs.en: Conversation bootstrap (CB). The resampling unit is the agent conversation; all transfers of a sampled conversation are pooled before each statistic is recomputed. The human reference is fixed, so intervals quantify agent-side uncertainty only. Table 1’s primary row and every tail probability in the inventory (Table A2 , rows 1–9, all three segmentations) use 10,000 draws, so the reporting floor 2 / ( B + 1 ) 2/(B+1) is 0.0002; the intervals of the other rows in Table A1 use 1,000 draws (300 for W 1 W_{1} ) and carry no tail probability. Two-sided tail probabilities against the fixed human statistic T H T_{H} are min { 1 , 2 min ( ( 1 + # { T b ≤ T H } ) / ( B + 1 ) , ( 1 + # { T b ≥ T H } ) / ( B + 1 ) ) } \min\{1,\,2\min((1+\#\{T_{b}\leq T_{H}\})/(B+1),\,(1+\#\{T_{b}\geq T_{H}\})/(B+1))\} , with reporting resolution 2 / ( B + 1 ) 2/(B+1) .
paragraphs.zh: 对话引导（CB）。重采样单元是智能体对话；每次重新计算统计量之前，都会对已采样的对话的所有转移进行汇总。人类参考值是固定的，因此区间仅用于量化智能体侧的不确定性。表1的主行以及库存中（表A2，第1–9行，所有三种分段）的每个尾部概率均使用10,000次抽样，因此报告下限 2 / ( B + 1 ) 2/(B+1) 为0.0002；表A1中其他行的区间使用1,000次抽样（W 1 W_{1} 使用300次），且不含尾部概率。针对固定的人类统计量 T H T_{H} 的双侧尾部概率为 min { 1 , 2 min ( ( 1 + # { T b ≤ T H } ) / ( B + 1 ) , ( 1 + # { T b ≥ T H } ) / ( B + 1 ) ) } \min\{1,\,2\min((1+\#\{T_{b}\leq T_{H}\})/(B+1),\,(1+\#\{T_{b}\geq T_{H}\})/(B+1))\} ，报告分辨率为 2 / ( B + 1 ) 2/(B+1) 。

paragraphs.en: Re-pairing surrogate (DP). Each of 2,000 derangements pairs one speaker’s complete activity track with a partner track from a different conversation, keeping the shared clock. The two-sided probability is ( 1 + c ) / ( B + 1 ) (1+c)/(B+1) , where c c counts surrogate statistics at least as far from the surrogate median as the observed one; the floor is 1 / 2001 1/2001 . Table 1’s re-paired row gives the central 95% of the surrogate statistics, not a confidence interval for the observed value. Restricting derangements to pairs staged in the same scene reproduces the free surrogate to within 0.005 of overlap and 0 ms of median.
paragraphs.zh: 重新配对的替代方案（DP）。在 2,000 种错排中，每种错排都将一位说话者的完整活动轨迹与来自不同对话的搭档轨迹进行配对，同时保留共享时钟。双边概率为 (1 + c) / (B + 1)，其中 c 表示替代统计量偏离替代中位数的程度至少与观测值相当；下限为 1/2001。表 1 中“重新配对”一行显示的是替代统计量的中间 95%，而非观测值的置信区间。若将错排限制在同一场景中发生的配对，则自由替代方案的重叠度误差可在 0.005 以内，中位数误差可在 0 毫秒以内。

paragraphs.en: Paired sign-flip contrasts (SF). Within each conversation and window the rate is 1000 × 1000\times markers/words pooled over both agents; the effect is the mean of paired per-conversation differences over pairs with at least one word in both arms. Two-sided probabilities use 20,000 random sign flips with the ( 1 + c ) / ( B + 1 ) (1+c)/(B+1) correction; intervals invert the same procedure and include zero whenever its null is accepted. The procedure assumes sign-exchangeability of the paired differences under the null. Excluding the forced opener removes its tokens from numerator and denominator alike.
paragraphs.zh: 成对符号翻转对比（SF）。在每次对话和每个窗口内，该比率是 1000 × 1000\times 标记/词，基于两个智能体合并计算；其效应为每对对话中差异的均值，仅针对至少有一词同时出现在两个分支中的成对数据。双侧概率采用 20,000 次随机符号翻转，并应用 ( 1 + c ) / ( B + 1 ) (1+c)/(B+1) 修正；置信区间的计算则反转相同过程，并在零假设被接受时始终包含零。该过程假设在零假设下成对差异具有符号可交换性。排除强制开场语后，其词元会从分子和分母中同时移除。

paragraphs.en: Exact sign tests (EB). The silence control uses the 12 matched persona-pair and scene cells; all 12 have more transfers with partner audio ( p = 2 / 2 12 = 4.9 × 10 − 4 p=2/2^{12}=4.9\times 10^{-4} ). The W 1 W_{1} check uses the 36 baseline conversations; each exceeds the median of its own size-matched clustered null ( p = 2 / 2 36 = 2.9 × 10 − 11 p=2/2^{36}=2.9\times 10^{-11} ).
paragraphs.zh: 精确符号检验（EB）。静默对照使用了12个匹配的人格对和场景单元格；所有12个单元格在与搭档音频配合时都表现出更多的转移（p = 2 / 2^{12} = 4.9 × 10^{-4}）。W₁检查使用了36个基准对话；每个对话都超过了与其规模匹配的聚类零假设的中位数（p = 2 / 2^{36} = 2.9 × 10^{-11}）。

paragraphs.en: Table A1 extends Table 1 with intervals for every baseline row and the on-time direction of each delay level. The contract is the same throughout: IPUs from spans separated by less than 180 ms; a floor transfer from the current speaker’s IPU end to the next speaker’s IPU start; nested IPUs excluded; identical-extent IPUs resolved by the floor holder; offsets clipped at ± 2 \pm 2 s.
paragraphs.zh: 表 A1 在表 1 的基础上扩展了每一行基线的区间以及每个延迟级别的准时方向。整个表格的约定保持一致：由间隔小于 180 毫秒的跨度产生的 IPU；从当前说话人的 IPU 结束到下一个说话人的 IPU 开始的地板转移；排除嵌套的 IPU；通过地板持有者解决范围相同的 IPU；偏移量在 ±2 \pm 2 秒处截断。

paragraphs.en: Per-conversation stability of the delay sweep. The paper’s modes are pooled over conversations. Per conversation, the modal offset of the delayed direction minus the injected delay has a median of 6, 6, 5.5, 5, and 4.5 frames at D = 0 D=0 , 3, 8, 10, 15; it lies within one frame of 6 + D 6+D in 26/36, 28/35, 22/36, 25/35, and 18/36 conversations at those levels, and exactly at 6 + D 6+D in 15, 14, 16, 14, and 8 of them. Conversations with fewer than three transfers in that direction are excluded, and when two frames tie for the mode the earlier one is taken, a rule that leans against the anchoring claim. The delayed side’s share of transfers that collide with the partner’s onset rises from 0.17 at D = 0 D=0 to 0.36 at D = 15 D=15 while the on-time side’s falls from 0.18 to 0.09 (Table A1 , overlap).
paragraphs.zh: 延迟扫描在每次对话中的稳定性。该论文的模式是在所有对话中汇总得到的。对于每次对话而言，延迟方向的模式偏移量减去注入的延迟，其中位数在 D = 0、3、8、10、15 时分别为 6、6、5.5、5 和 4.5 帧；在这些延迟水平下，有 26/36、28/35、22/36、25/35 和 18/36 次对话的模式偏移量与 6 + D 的差值不超过 1 帧，另有 15、14、16、14 和 8 次对话的模式偏移量恰好等于 6 + D。若某方向上的传输次数少于三次，则排除该次对话；当两个帧数并列成为模式时，取较早出现的那个值，这一规则与锚定假设相悖。延迟侧与搭档方起始时刻发生冲突的传输比例从 D = 0 时的 0.17 上升到 D = 15 时的 0.36，而准时侧的比例则从 0.18 下降到 0.09（表 A1，“重叠”部分）。

paragraphs.en: Recorded partner. Each of 72 agent runs faces a 90 s window of one AMI Headset-0 recording (ES2003a or ES2004a; 24 windows at a 20 s step), Mimi-encoded after level-matching the recording to decoded Mimi speech (median of the loudest 15% of 80 ms frames scaled to 0.04 RMS; gains × 7 \times 7 – × 14 \times 14 ), and delivered one frame late for parity with the room’s buffering. The human side is segmented from its stored frame energy under the same 0.01 gate as the agent side (voiced fraction median 0.31). Human → \to agent transfers: n = 384 n=384 , median 240 ms, mode 4 frames holding 0.12 of transfers (frame 6 holds 0.08, against 0.23 in the matching direction of live dyads), overlap 0.22, band share 0.16. A mismatched-window null that scores each agent’s onsets against the window a different agent heard (300 derangements) gives mode share 0.09 [ 0.07 , 0.13 ] [0.07,0.13] ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 for the observed 0.12) and band share 0.15 [ 0.11 , 0.19 ] [0.11,0.19] . The agents’ speech share is 0.15 against 0.35 in the baseline dyads. Two earlier recordings (ES2002a, ES2005a) were excluded before analysis because their crosstalk sits at the gate after level-matching (more than a quarter of frames within a factor of two of 0.01 RMS).
paragraphs.zh: 已记录的合作者。72次智能体运行中的每一次都面临一个90秒的窗口，其中包含一段AMI Headset-0录音（ES2003a或ES2004a；以20秒为步长，共24个窗口）。该录音在与解码后的Mimi语音进行电平匹配后，经过Mimi编码（将最响亮的15%的80毫秒帧的中位数缩放至0.04 RMS；增益为×7 \times 7 – ×14 \times 14），并延迟一个帧传输，以与房间的缓冲同步。人类侧的数据则根据与智能体侧相同的0.01门限对其存储的帧能量进行分段（有声音部分的中位数为0.31）。从人类到智能体的传输：n = 384 n=384，中位数为240毫秒，众数为4帧，占传输总量的0.12（第6帧占0.08，而实时对话对中的对应方向为0.23），重叠度为0.22，频段共享率为0.16。一个窗口不匹配的零假设将每个智能体的起始点与另一个智能体所听到的窗口进行评分（共300种错配情况），其众数共享率为0.09 [ 0.07 , 0.13 ] [0.07,0.13]（观测到的0.12对应的 p = 0.04 p=0.04），频段共享率为0.15 [ 0.11 , 0.19 ] [0.11,0.19]。智能体的语音共享率为0.15，而基线对话对中的该比率为0.35。在分析前排除了两段较早的录音（ES2002a、ES2005a），因为它们在电平匹配后仍存在串音（超过四分之一的帧其RMS值在0.01的两倍范围内）。

paragraphs.en: Clip. W 1 W_{1} is computed between distributions clipped at ± 2 \pm 2 s. The clip holds 0.7% of the human reference (0.05% beyond ± 4 \pm 4 s), 0.5% of the baseline energy transfers, 0.1% of the forced-opener arm, 0.2%, 0.1%, 0.1%, and 0.7% of the D = 3 D=3 , 8, 10, 15 arms, 0.8% of the recorded-partner arm, and 38.3% of the silence control’s 26 transfers. Widening the clip to ± 4 \pm 4 s moves the baseline energy W 1 W_{1} from 228 to 231 ms.
paragraphs.zh: 剪辑。W 1 W_{1} 是在以 ±2 \pm 2 s 为边界的分布之间计算的。该剪辑包含人类参考数据的 0.7%（超出 ±4 \pm 4 s 的部分为 0.05%）、基线能量转移的 0.5%、强制开启臂的 0.1%，以及 D = 3 D=3、8、10、15 个臂的 0.2%、0.1%、0.1% 和 0.7%；记录伙伴臂的 0.8%，以及沉默对照组 26 次转移中的 38.3%。将剪辑范围扩大至 ±4 \pm 4 s，会使基线能量 W 1 W_{1} 从 228 ms 变为 231 ms。

paragraphs.en: Grid. Agent offsets lie on the 80 ms frame grid; human word boundaries are continuous. Rounding the human boundaries outward to the grid (starts floored, ends ceiled) moves the human median from 137 to 80 ms and raises the baseline energy W 1 W_{1} from 228 to 266 ms, so the grid works against the deficits the paper reports, not for them. The paper keeps continuous human boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 网格。智能体偏移量位于 80 毫秒的帧网格上；人类的词界则是连续的。将人类词界向外取整以适配网格（起点向下取整，终点向上取整），会使人类的中间值从 137 毫秒变为 80 毫秒，并将基线能量 W 1 W_{1} 从 228 毫秒提升至 266 毫秒。因此，该网格实际上抵消了论文中报告的能量缺失，而非加剧这种缺失。而论文本身则保留了连续的人类词界。

paragraphs.en: Backchannel-like material. No lexical backchannel filter is applied on either side. Under the shared rule the share of different-speaker adjacencies that are nested (and therefore not transfers) is 14.2% in Switchboard (31,355 of 221,502) and 16.3%, 13.7%, and 14.1% for the agents under the energy, text-word, and aligned-word segmentations; the share of IPUs shorter than 1 s is 42.6% for humans and 45.2%, 84.3%, and 50.1% for the agents.
paragraphs.zh: 类似回应的材料。双方均未应用词汇回应过滤器。根据共享规则，不同说话者相邻语段中嵌套（因此不属于转移）的比例在 Switchboard 数据集中为 14.2%（31,355/221,502），而对于采用能量、文本词和对齐词分段的智能体，该比例分别为 16.3%、13.7% 和 14.1%；时长短于 1 秒的 IPU 在人类中占比为 42.6%，而在智能体中则分别为 45.2%、84.3% 和 50.1%。

paragraphs.en: Phase-matched reference. Restricting the reference to the first 90 s of each Switchboard call gives 43,890 transfers, median 163 ms, overlap 0.28, band share 0.25, and lowers the baseline energy W 1 W_{1} from 228 to 215 ms. Shifting this reference to each agent median gives the median-matched comparison: overlap 0.175 against 0.084 (energy), 0.142 against 0.058 (text), 0.183 against 0.119 (aligned); band share 0.033 against 0.095, 0.088 against 0.072, and 0.043 against 0.122.
paragraphs.zh: 相位匹配参考。将参考限制在每次 Switchboard 通话的前 90 秒，可获得 43,890 次传输，中位数为 163 毫秒，重叠度为 0.28，频段占比为 0.25，并将基线能量 W 1 W_{1} 从 228 降低至 215 毫秒。将此参考调整至每个智能体的中位数，即可得到中位数匹配比较：重叠度分别为 0.175（能量）和 0.084，0.142（文本）和 0.058，0.183（对齐）和 0.119；频段占比分别为 0.033 和 0.095，0.088 和 0.072，以及 0.043 和 0.122。

paragraphs.en: Status is relative to α ∗ \alpha_{*} : Below, Nominal ( α ∗ < p ≤ 0.05 \alpha_{*}<p\leq 0.05 ), or Above. Archive labels are kept for traceability; “pp_F” is the baseline, “pp_G” the forced-opener arm, “pp_deaf” the silence control.
paragraphs.zh: 状态是相对于 α ∗ \alpha_{*} 的：分为“低于”（Nominal，即 α ∗ < p ≤ 0.05 \alpha_{*}<p\leq 0.05）或“高于”。存档标签保留以确保可追溯性；“pp_F”为基线，“pp_G”为强制开启组，“pp_deaf”为沉默对照组。

paragraphs.en: The lexicon has 21 patterns in three categories (greeting-by-name, service offers, telephone framing) and was written after inspecting the baseline transcripts; the baseline holds 58 markers, 38 of them in the first 10 s (66% of markers in 14% of the words). The five openers are one scene-appropriate sentence per scene, placed in the first speaker’s speech with timing left to the agent. Table A3 gives every window and contrast; the paper’s Fig. 3b plots the 0–10, 10–30, and 30–90 s rates of all three arms and its text quotes the 0–10 and 0–90 s contrasts.
paragraphs.zh: 该词汇表包含三个类别（按姓名问候、服务提供和电话框架）中的 21 种模式，并在检查了基准转录本后编写而成；基准转录本包含 58 个标记，其中 38 个出现在前 10 秒内（即 14% 的词语中包含了 66% 的标记）。五个开场白为每个场景提供一句符合场景语境的句子，并置于第一位发言者的话语中，具体时机由智能体决定。表 A3 列出了所有窗口和对比情况；本文的图 3b 绘制了所有三个分支在 0–10、10–30 和 30–90 秒内的比率，其文本部分则引用了 0–10 和 0–90 秒的对比数据。

paragraphs.en: Prompt compliance. The prompt condition gives the same sentence to the same agent as a system-prompt instruction (“Your first words to them are: …”), with the same seeds. Compliance is the share of the opener’s content words (longer than three letters) that occur anywhere in the instructed agent’s first 60 words; 8 of 36 agents reach 80%, 8 of 36 produce none. The 10–90 s prompt contrast retains the 34 pairs with words in both arms.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词遵从性。提示词条件向同一智能体提供相同的句子作为系统提示指令（“你对他们的第一句话是：……”），并使用相同的种子值。遵从性是指开场白中内容词（长度超过三个字母）在受指令智能体的前60个词中出现的比例；36个智能体中有8个达到了80%，另有8个完全没有出现。10–90秒的提示词对比保留了双臂中均包含词语的34对。

paragraphs.en: Human offsets tighten within a conversation at − 1.45 -1.45 ms/s (SE 0.08); the agents’ slope is − 0.34 -0.34 (SE 0.69). A conversation fixed-effects model with cluster-robust uncertainty gives a system × \times time interaction of + 1.11 +1.11 ms/s, 95% CI [ − 0.24 , + 2.45 ] [-0.24,+2.45] , p = 0.11 p=0.11 (wild cluster bootstrap 0.12); the design has 56% power against a human-sized effect. The paper does not report this contrast as a finding.
paragraphs.zh: 人类偏移量在对话中的变化幅度收紧至 −1.45 -1.45 ms/s（SE 0.08）；智能体的斜率为 −0.34 -0.34（SE 0.69）。采用聚类稳健不确定性的对话固定效应模型得出，系统 × \times 时间的交互效应为 +1.11 +1.11 ms/s，95% CI [−0.24, +2.45] [-0.24,+2.45]，p = 0.11 p=0.11（wild cluster bootstrap 0.12）；该设计在检测与人类效应量相当的效果时具有 56% 的检验力。本文并未将此对比结果作为研究结论进行报告。

paragraphs.en: Let t s t_{s} be the source speaker’s IPU end, t r ( q ) t_{r}^{(q)} the time the corresponding audio becomes readable at codebook q q , and t o t_{o} the responding agent’s onset, all on the shared clock. With base codebook delay δ q \delta_{q} (160 ms coarse, 240 ms fine) and added one-sided delay D D frames,
paragraphs.zh: 令 t s t_{s} 为源说话者的 IPU 结束时间，t r ( q ) t_{r}^{(q)} 为对应音频在码本 q q 中变为可读的时间，以及 t o t_{o} 为响应智能体的起始时间，所有时间均基于共享时钟。设基础码本延迟为 δ q \delta_{q}（粗略延迟 160 ms，精细延迟 240 ms），并额外增加单向延迟 D D 帧，

paragraphs.en: The paper’s offsets are t o − t s t_{o}-t_{s} . The observed modes of 6 + D 6+D frames leave a 480 ms mode after subtracting 80 ​ D 80D ; that residual still contains δ q \delta_{q} , so the wait after the fine path is about 240 ms. The sweep establishes that the wait is anchored to t r t_{r} and is not shortened as D D grows; it does not by itself separate a fixed threshold from a projection that starts after the perceived end. What separates them in the paper is the distribution’s shape at D = 0 D=0 : 0.011 of agent transfers fall in [ − 120 , 0 ) [-120,0) ms against 0.104 for humans, and 90% of positive agent offsets exceed 320 ms against 42% for humans, so onsets in the approach to the perceived end, which projection produces and endpointing cannot, are all but absent; the agents’ remaining overlaps lie deeper in the partner’s turn (among overlaps beyond 120 ms, median − 560 -560 ms against − 311 -311 ms for the human ones). Chang et al.’s generate-to-perceive lag of about 0.6 s under interruption is consistent with the residual and is not identified by floor timing alone.
paragraphs.zh: 该论文中的偏移量为 t o − t s t_{o}-t_{s}。对 6 + D 6+D 帧的观察模式在减去 80​ D 80D 后，会留下一个 480 毫秒的模式；该残差仍包含 δ q \delta_{q}，因此精细路径之后的等待时间约为 240 毫秒。扫描实验表明，该等待时间以 t r t_{r} 为锚点，并且随着 D D 增大而不会缩短；仅凭这一点无法将固定阈值与在感知结束之后才开始的项目区分开来。在该论文中，区分二者的关键在于 D = 0 D=0 时分布的形状：智能体转移中有 0.011 落在 [ − 120 , 0 ) [-120,0) 毫秒区间内，而人类为 0.104；同时，90% 的智能体正向偏移量超过 320 毫秒，而人类仅为 42%。因此，在接近感知结束阶段的项目起始（这种起始是投影产生的，而非终点确定所能产生）几乎完全不存在；智能体剩余的重叠部分则更深入于搭档的轮次中（在超过 120 毫秒的重叠中，中位数为 − 560 -560 毫秒，而人类为 − 311 -311 毫秒）。Chang 等人提出的、在中断条件下“生成-感知”延迟约为 0.6 秒的结论与上述残差一致，并且仅通过底层时间测量无法识别出这一延迟。
